SuperGaming is a Series B-funded game development company headquartered in Singapore with studios in Pune, India. Our founders have been building gaming startups for over a decade and were among the first Indian companies to get into Y Combinator.

Making games is the highest form of craft for a software engineer. You'll work at the forefront of realtime multiplayer tech, on games played by millions — Indus, Prime Rush, MaskGun — and on SuperPlatform, the engine that runs them all.
